packages.name: 7-Zip
packages.description: File archiver with a high compression ratio (7z, ZIP, RAR extraction, TAR, GZIP and more).
packages.license: LGPL-2.1-or-later AND BSD-3-Clause, with unRAR license restriction

installers.notes: 7-Zip's official site states: '7-Zip works in Windows 11 / 10 / 8 / 7 / Vista / XP ...' (https://www.7-zip.org/). The installers are not Authenticode-signed by the publisher; integrity relies on the SHA-256 in the signed repository metadata. Silent switches from https://www.7-zip.org/faq.html; the exe installer writes HKLM\...\Uninstall\7-Zip with a QuietUninstallString (C/Util/7zipInstall/7zipInstall.c).

packages.name: PuTTY
packages.description: SSH and Telnet client with SCP/SFTP tools (portable ZIP: putty, pscp, psftp, plink, pageant, puttygen).

installers.notes: The PuTTY FAQ only promises support for Windows versions still in security support and makes no Windows 7 claim for 0.85, so this release is conservatively marked for Windows 10 (NT 10.0) and later. Windows 7 users get 0.83. SHA-256 values match the vendor's sha256sums file.

The PuTTY FAQ only promises support for Windows versions still in security support and makes no Windows 7 claim for 0.85, so this release is conservatively marked for Windows 10 (NT 10.0) and later. Windows 7 users get 0.83. SHA-256 values match the vendor's sha256sums file.

The PuTTY FAQ (https://www.chiark.greenend.org.uk/~sgtatham/putty/faq.html) states that 'PuTTY 0.83 still runs on Windows XP', so it is marked compatible with Windows 7 (NT 6.1). SHA-256 values match the vendor's sha256sums file; every executable is Authenticode-signed by 'Simon Tatham'.
